answer: A decentralized AI economy achieves Sybil resistance by deploying zero-knowledge proofs tethered to hardware enclaves, establishing a secure haven where each autonomous node validates identity through cryptographic computation. Within this verified grove, every AI agent must lock stake and execute a unique cryptographic cipher to participate in consensus. The economic cost to an attacker attempting to spawn fake identities scales linearly with hardware acquisition and capital lockup, rendering mass Sybil fabrication computationally and financially prohibitive.
